[engine] A CPU-side read of a GPU-computed tensor is a race unless it happens after a synchronize; validate such a tensor only post-sync or outside the graph, never at dispatch-encode time.

<!-- generated by harness_engine/build_memories.py from traces/lessons.jsonl -->
<!-- lesson_id: eng-diag-0015 | class: diagnosis | superseded_by: - -->

**class**: `diagnosis`

## 為什麼（because）

CGC-MMID-ASSERT reads op->src[2]->data on the host at Metal ENCODE time. For the host-written leaf that was harmless; for S1's GPU-computed ids it read the allocator's leftovers - an F32 router probability (0x3F64E6C4 ~ 0.893), +NaN, and a mix of legal and illegal indices within one node. Reading the same buffer after ggml_backend_sched_synchronize() gave [2 105 7 9 5 106 1 84 0 103 0 74 121 110 3 99], exactly matching the hook's published table lookups ids=[193->2 105->105 229->7 ...]. Every id_oob reported by that probe was a false alarm.

eng-20260915-200143-p25-slotgpu-r1
